en:
I want to check this floor for any peculiar
objects, but...

Did you notice the hanging scroll beyond
the shrine gate? Nothing's written on it.

Yeah, that was bothering me as well.
It's strange.

They probably made all this to create an
atmosphere. See if you can use the junk here.
Right. Leave it to me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki has never been this cooperative
with investigations before...

<CLT=cltMIND>She must have been serious about
what she said after the trial.
...What? Why are you making that gross face?
Wh-What!? It's not *gross*...is it?

I'm just happy... It's, ah, really nice
that you're working with us like this.

Well, unlike Kaito, I'm not just all talk.
I always follow through with my decisions.
Maki...

The hanging scroll beyond the shrine gate...
Nothing's written on it.
Hurry and check if you can use the junk on it.

Hey, did you check around the 
shrine gate, too?
No, not yet. Why?
I remember Kiyo telling me this before...

Shrine gates are the <CLT=cltSTRONG>entrances<CLT=cltNORMAL> to holy grounds,
and holy grounds have barriers around them...

When you think of it like that, there may be
a secret entrance somewhere around here.
I wouldn't put it past Kiyo.

I still don't get that stuff with his sister 
or why he killed Angie and Tenko...

But Kiyo really was an excellent
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Anthropologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if Kiyo had made it out of
here alive...

<CLT=cltMIND>He might have made even more
<CLT=cltSTRONG>friends<CLT=cltMIND> for his sister.

I still don't get that stuff with his sister 
or why he killed Angie and Tenko...

But Kiyo really was an excellent
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Anthropologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma never backed down from his
claim that <CLT=cltMIND>the dead can be resurrected<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>This academy isn't normal.
I know that.

<CLT=cltMIND>But is it so <CLT=cltMIND>abnormal<CLT=cltMIND> that
something like *that* can happen?
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo, you said...

<CLT=cltMIND>How you come to terms with death
determines how you live.
<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps...I understand what you mean.

<CLT=cltMIND>By facing Kaede's death...I was able to
embrace my own talent and move forward.

But I don't know if I'll ever truly
understand your <CLT=cltSTRONG>answer<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Angie...

<CLT=cltMIND>You had strange methods, but you rejected the
killing game and wanted us to live in harmony.

<CLT=cltMIND>But all that was taken away for
some stupid reason.

<CLT=cltMIND>I never knew your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Atua<CLT=cltMIND>,
but I will never forget you.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us,
but why is it so...gaudy?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's not just the monitor,
it's this entire academy.
<CLT=cltMIND>What is going on here...?

<CLT=cltMIND>A staircase...
It seems you can go upstairs from here.

The fifth floor, huh?
How many floors does this school have?
